statistical_association_notes: Historical association: Strong El Nino events lead to reduced Cauvery catchment rainfall, decreasing delta irrigation and reducing rice yield by ~12%.
Historical association: Monsoon rainfall deficits under El Nino impair water table recharge, reducing late-Kharif sowing and winter Rabi onion yields.
Historical association: Canal and tube-well irrigation highly buffer monsoon rainfall deficits, but winter temperature anomalies associated with El Nino can reduce yields.
Historical association: High vulnerability; rainfed sorghum in dryland Solapur suffers up to 26% yield reduction during El Nino drought years.
